description: Land Acquisition - Mabima, Pattiwila, Biyagama D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily focused on land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes, including their locations, boundaries, and extents. The document is published in the "PART III - LANDS" section of the gazette and deals exclusively with property acquisition, boundaries, and land ownership claims, which aligns perfectly with the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
